test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Except the editing, all the other relevant parts of the movie _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3) i.e. 'are excellent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Are excellent"** is grammatically correct because it agrees with the **plural subject** **"all the other parts"**, indicating multiple parts of the movie are being described.
 
• It uses the simple present tense correctly to describe the current state or quality of the movie parts.

**Therefore, the correct answer is- *"Except the editing, all the other relevant parts of the movie are excellent__."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) "is excellent":** Incorrect because it does not agree in number with the plural subject "parts".
 
• **Option 2) "are being excellent": **Incorrect because it implies an ongoing state of becoming excellent, which is not the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 4) "was excellent": **Incorrect because it uses past tense, while the sentence requires present tense to describe the current quality.
